name: Asenovgrad

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

soil.rock: Schist, slate and gneiss break into stony, free-draining soil that holds the day's heat. Schist is rich in magnesium and potassium but poor in organic matter and nitrogen.

land: The high ground runs about 10°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
